question: Should `record.sessionKey` be accepted as a supported public channel-inbound SDK contract for plugins that dispatch in one session while recording inbound context against another?
rationale: The branch documents and exports a generic record-target override with transcript and session-state effects; that API boundary is a durable compatibility choice rather than a mechanical correctness repair.

options.title: Approve the focused SDK contract
options.body: Keep the documented override, with the current focused kernel coverage and explicit real-world channel proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the behavior plugin-owned
options.body: Avoid widening the shared SDK and redesign Telegram's command-to-target bookkeeping within its existing owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the focused SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the documented override, with the current focused kernel coverage and explicit real-world channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Mattermost lifecycle ownership plus the protected maintainer review signal make this the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-channel boundary decision.
